description: A circular, notification or press release announcing a change → what changed, who it applies to, by when, and what a regulated entity must do.
instructions: The document announces or amends a regulatory requirement. Identify the issuing regulator and its reference number exactly as printed. Summarise the change in plain language for a compliance manager. List the concrete actions a regulated entity must take and every date the document sets (issue, effective, compliance deadline, reporting). Do not invent dates; use ISO format where a full date is given.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: What changed, in two or three sentences

fields.name: affectedAreas
fields.description: Functions or topics affected (e.g. outsourcing, KYC, cyber incident reporting)

fields.name: actionsRequired
fields.description: Concrete actions the entity must take

textAny: \b(hereby|with immediate effect|come into force|shall be applicable)\b
